guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the two potion rewards after a Rest are missing entirely, and the stub's stated premise is false
guards.issue: MECHANISM: TinyMailbox.cs:14-24 adds TWO `new PotionReward(player)` entries to the rest-site heal reward list and returns true. tiny_mailbox.py is a class body with an id, a name and a rarity -- no methods at all -- justified by the docstring 'an out-of-combat rest-site reward, so this is a no-op stub' (tiny_mailbox.py:8-9). PROMPT.md bug class 12 says to check the premise; it is false in four separate ways, all executed (`py tools/audit/relic_probes_b16.py mailbox-rest`): (1) `Relic.modify_rest_site_heal_rewards` exists on the base (relics/base.py:245-249); (2) RunState.rest_heal_rewards dispatches it over every relic (run.py:1097-1110); (3) a SIBLING ported relic already uses it -- relics/dream_catcher.py:22-25, also an Event relic from the same Trash Heap pool -- and the probe shows it producing cards=['feel_no_pain', 'rampage', 'iron_wave'] on the same seed where tiny_mailbox produces nothing; (4) the destination field for exactly this reward shape exists and is consumed: CombatRewards.special_potions (rewards.py:385-388, 'Extra potion offers (PotionReward extras)') is surfaced as an independent take-or-skip offer by driver.py:388-390, and run.random_potion() works (probe: 'clarity'). So the relic is a complete no-op where the game gives two potions per rest. Both sides ported: Uncommon in the grab bag, and the sim has rest sites with a heal option and a reward screen. SCOPE NOTE, stated because it is arguable: the shared contract defers potions, but what is missing here is the RELIC's hook implementation, not any potion mechanic -- the sim's potion-reward pipeline is built, dispatched and consumed, and the same hook is already implemented by a sibling. Filed as a gap on the belt_buckle precedent (audits/relic/belt_buckle.json AfterPotionProcured), where a potion-triggered divergence was recorded rather than waived because the divergent observable was ordinary run state. Rule 7: relics/base.py, run.py, rewards.py, driver.py and relics/dream_catcher.py are NOT hashed by this record.

guards.what: N2: the `isMimicked` parameter of TryModifyRestSiteHealRewards, and the C# return value
guards.rationale: TinyMailbox ignores `isMimicked` entirely -- it adds the two potions whether the heal came from the rest site or from PlayerCmd.MimicRestSiteHeal (PlayerCmd.cs:264) -- so a port that also ignores it is correct, and the sim's hook signature (run, rewards) drops a parameter no implementer here reads. The `return true` is the Try-chain's 'I modified something' flag, which audits/seam/hook_dispatch.json step 34 already verdicts as a deliberate-divergence collapsed into a void mutator across the whole family; matched here rather than re-derived (binding rule 3). Rule 7: PlayerCmd.cs and audits/seam/hook_dispatch.json are not hashed here.

guards.what: N3: `rewards.Add(new PotionReward(player))` TWICE rather than one two-potion reward
guards.rationale: Recorded for whoever implements G1: they are two independent take-or-skip offers, not a pick-one-of-two, so the fix is two appends to CombatRewards.special_potions (which driver.py:388-390 already offers one at a time) and NOT the single `rewards.potion` pity slot. Each PotionReward rolls its own potion, so the fix also costs two potion-generation draws -- relevant to RNG parity, and the reason a one-line 'give 2 potions' shortcut would be wrong.
